choices.label: Motorcycle parked beside charred chapel stones on the morning shore
Poet steps onto shore water; sea wave amplitude flattens to 0 under feet
Cards 1–5: White marble plinth courses snap onto the ruin ground line
Cards 6–11: Six fluted columns rise and occlude Poet's walk in rhythm
Cards 12–16: Architrave beams and edgeless mirror pool lock into place
Cards 17–19: Temple finial locks; dawn light-line bisects the reflection

I2_threshold.rule: All 19 architectural cards of the White Temple lock onto the ground line (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Temple cards count is strictly non-decreasing (0 -> 19); 6 columns occlude Poet on alternating beats.
